abstract: Run scheduler_executor in dry-run mode to map the harmony plan (allowed_ops) to concrete shallow ops without executing writes. Prints planned ops and reasons.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.scheduler_executor import run_executor

def main():
    out = run_executor(dry_run=True)
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
